business_summary: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings Co., Ltd. (HKEX: 1919) is a Chinese container liner operator that halted Hormuz transits on safety grounds alongside Maersk, ONE, Evergreen, HMM and Yang Ming when vessels were unable to exit the Gulf in early March 2026, and manages Gulf cargo through phased port acceptance.
